from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """One court document with information needed for case type classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The actual title of this court document")
    law_cited: str | None = Field(description="The primary law(s) cited in the document, e.g. '国家赔偿法', '刑事诉讼法', '行政诉讼法', '民事诉讼法', '公司法'")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The nature of the legal dispute, e.g. '国家赔偿争议', '刑事犯罪', '执行异议', '行政诉讼', '民事合同纠纷'")
    proceeding_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of proceeding, e.g. '赔偿监督程序', '申诉', '执行异议', '再审', '二审'")
    key_entities: str | None = Field(description="Key parties involved, e.g. '赔偿请求人与赔偿义务机关', '被告人', '行政机关', '当事人'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document anchoring the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
